sample.description:

On this episode of Leaders, she speaks with Francine Lacqua about her work in Nigeria and how it led to her mother's abduction, how the US trade war and geopolitics are putting tremendous strain on global trade and why it’s time to re-imagine globalization.

What drives the world’s most influential minds? In Leaders with Francine Lacqua, Bloomberg’s award-winning anchor sits down with the decision-makers shaping our future to explore the personal stories behind their public personas. Discover what inspires them, how they navigate power and the lessons they offer on defining success. Insightful, cinematic and elegantly crafted, Leaders goes beyond the headlines to reveal the human side of leadership.

sample.title: Why Retailers Are Shrinking Their Assortments
sample.description:
From Dollar General to Under Armour, retailers are culling assortments to get back to healthy growth, or at least, stabilize their business. For brands, excess inventory usually leads to discounting, which in turn hurts profitability. For box stores, slicing merchandise is more of a defensive play that allows for better curation. Watch the video to learn about why some retailers are giving consumers less choice.

Zelensky says Russia hit Ukrainian power plant after Trump declared energy ceasefire | BBC News
sample.description:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky says Russia hit a power plant in Ukraine "immediately after" US President Donald Trump announced what he called an energy ceasefire.

Zelensky said Ukraine is willing to back an energy truce if Moscow does as well, adding that it could "become a major step toward ending the war."

So far, the Kremlin has not commented on the idea, which could see both sides pausing attacks on each other's energy facilities.

Trump has been urging Ukraine to stop strikes on Russian oil infrastructure so Moscow can fulfil a recently struck deal to release diesel to the US and the global market.
